atlases.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: texture atlas of French collège wall posters. Generate one square 2048x2048 image arranged as an EXACT 4-column by 4-row grid containing sixteen DISTINCT square illustrated print designs. Tiles abut edge-to-edge, no gutters or gaps. Each tile occupies exactly one quarter of width and height, with no elements crossing its edge. No photographic rooms, mockup perspective, picture frames, outer border, grid labels, tile numbers or captions outside posters. Each tile IS a flat standalone poster, boldly illustrated in cheerful contemporary French school editorial gouache and screen-print style, strong silhouette and vivid ink colors, subtle paper texture. Artwork should dominate; only the specified short French title appears inside each tile in large readable lettering. Use varied compositions and color schemes, distinct illustrations for every tile. Respect exact row/column placements below, counting left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Avoid dense copy and generic repeated icons.
